text: This is a B1 text about friends. In modern society, friends plays a surprisingly significant role. Although some people might dismiss it as trivial, the impact of friends on our daily lives is undeniable. For instance, when we consider how much time and resources are devoted to friends, it becomes clear that it shapes our cultural landscape. Personally, I have found that engaging with friends has broadened my horizons and allowed me to connect with diverse groups of people.
